# Cardmeister

Author: Danny Engelman. Original project: https://github.com/cardmeister/cardmeister.github.io

This is the unchanged asset previously loaded from https://cardmeister.github.io/elements.cardmeister.full.js, retrieved on 2026-10-13 and served locally to preserve card appearance and remove remote script execution at runtime.

The upstream README declares the Unlicense/public-domain dedication and reproduces the Unlicense text. Its package.json separately declares CC0. We record both statements rather than invent a different license. See the upstream README for the full dedication and original resource credits.
